bp_p1_desc: PrinceDormand78 high-precision adaptive integrator with periapsis, apoapsis, and equatorial latitude-crossing stop conditions.

bp_p3_desc: Realistic thruster + mass-decrement tank + finite burn segment, targeting BurnDuration to achieve desired orbital radius.
bp_p3_title: Paradigm 3: Target Finite Burn with Mass Decrement
bp_p4_desc: NearEarth -> DeepSpace -> NearMars 3-stage force models, targeting TCM to achieve B-Plane (BdotT, BdotR) and insertion burn.
bp_p5_desc: Multi-segment control points, forward and backward integration matching with differential correction for position/velocity continuity.
bp_p6_desc: Ion/Hall electric thruster + high-Isp tank, long-duration adaptive low-thrust spiral-out and interplanetary cruise.
bp_p7_desc: 16-digit precision telemetry formatting, exporting Cartesian states, Keplerian elements, and spacecraft mass for Principia validation.

craft_eph_verify: GMAT Ephemeris vs Principia N-Body Dynamics Verification
craft_explain_1_title: I. Theory & Physics: Strictly Impossible to Be Zero (Objective Physics)
craft_explain_1a: 1. N-body Chaos & Non-integrability: Three-body and higher systems have no analytical solution; numerical integration inevitably incurs discretization error and floating-point roundoff;
craft_explain_1b: 2. Ephemeris vs Symplectic Integrator: GMAT uses JPL DE405 Chebyshev polynomials, while Principia uses online symplectic integration, resulting in microscopic truncation discrepancies;
craft_explain_1c: 3. Light-time Delay & Relativistic Corrections: Different tensor projection conventions produce millimeter-level geometric tolerance.
craft_explain_2_title: II. Engineering Practice & Trajectory Design: Fully Negligible at Current Precision
craft_explain_2a: 1. Microscopic Relative Error: Velocity discrepancy < 0.0001 m/s (0.1 mm/s) is well beyond the accuracy limits of real flight-grade IMUs and star trackers;
craft_explain_2b: 2. Closed-loop Maneuver Absorption: Minor perturbation differences are seamlessly absorbed by standard Trajectory Correction Maneuvers (TCM);
craft_explain_2c: 3. NASA Flight Standard: This level of agreement meets the industry standard of NASA deep space missions (e.g. Artemis, Cassini) Orbit Determination (OD)!
craft_explain_title: Aerospace Engineering Insights: Can These Errors Be Avoided?
